card.name: First digit of two-digit numbers
card.fires_on: A single leading digit (1, 2, 3, 4, 7) that begins a two-digit number, where the next digit is still to come. It appears mostly in dose amounts, hours and dates.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: The first digit of a two-digit dose or time value before mg or hours.

modes.label: Dates and general figures
modes.description: The first digit of a day, ordinal or percentage in general text.
modes.example: referring to the Millennium Celebrations on January <<3>>1, 2000.

card.writes: It suppresses 'sch'-type pieces and promotes 'scholar' words, which looks incidental and not tied to the number context.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a two-digit number, such as the 2 in 20 mg, just before the second digit.
